title: Sundara Kandam
desc: Priya, a young student, falls in love with her teacher, a man who shows no interest in her. Complications arise when the professor gets married, and she continues to stir trouble in his life.

title: Mannuketha Ponnu
desc: A man is very loyal towards his master who has also raised him. When his master's daughter returns to the village, the two fall in love after initial hiccups.

title: Oru Kai Osai
desc: A man loses his voice after his mother's shocking death. Later, he falls in love with a doctor, who comes to practise in his village and helps everyone.

title: Vandhaan Vendraan
desc: On the request of the woman he loves, Arjun goes to great lengths to put his half-brother Ramana, who is a don, behind bars. However, his attempts put him in a dangerous situation.
